subject: general
question: Sofia sold an iPhone at the cost of Rs.46,068 at a loss of 12%. At what cost will she have to sell it to get a profit of 18%?
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of the iPhone is = Rs.46,068

Loss = 12%

**Formula used:**

Loss = Cost Price-selling price

%Loss = ( loss)/( cost Price) × 100

%Profit = ( selling price- cost price)/( cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Now,

12 = ( cost price -46,068)/( cost price) × 100

 ⇒ 0.12cost price = cost price - 46,068

 ⇒ 0.88cost price = 46,068

 ⇒ cost price = (46,068)/(0.88)

Cost Price = Rs.52350

The %profit:

⇒ 18 = (selling price - 52,350)/(52,350) ×100

⇒ Selling Price - 52,350 = 9423

⇒ Selling Price = 61,773

Hence, the correct answer is **Rs. 61,773.**
